basic_cast.name: Basic Cast
basic_cast.desc: Quick wand flick releasing a sparkling bolt of magic.

stupefy.name: Stupefy
stupefy.desc: Stunning spell. Hits target, deals high damage and stuns for up to 1.8 seconds.

incendio.name: Incendio
incendio.desc: Roaring cone of magical fire. Blast damage to everything in the cone, then burns over 3 seconds. Extra damage against Inferi.

bombarda.name: Bombarda
bombarda.desc: Detonates a violent concussive shockwave. Heavy AOE damage; enemies in the blast are thrown through the air and lie stunned for a moment where they land.

expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
expelliarmus.desc: Disarming charm. Knocks back the target, interrupts casting and reduces its attack power by 35% for 5 seconds.

protego.name: Protego
protego.desc: Shimmering forcefield. Projectiles that strike it are reflected at their caster; all other damage is reduced by 60%.

ultimate.name: Stella Ruina
ultimate.desc: Ultimate star sorcery. Calls down a falling star that bursts into a violet ring of starlight, scorching everything in a wide blast radius; its shards leave every enemy hit bleeding for 4 seconds.

patronum.name: Expecto Patronum
patronum.desc: Conjures a silver stag that charges through a wide cone. Dementors take triple damage and the stag breaks a dementor's attack, kiss included; everything it charges through is slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Requires level 40.

glacius.name: Glacius
glacius.desc: Frost nova. Hurls a spinning ice crystal that bursts into shards and freezing mist, freezing every enemy in the blast solid for up to 1.6 seconds; thawed enemies stay chilled and slowed for 2.5 seconds. Requires level 20.
